answer: Each identity keeps its earnings in a vault that only unlocks while it maintains a live thread of verified work: every completed task mints a relic, a signed receipt chained to the last, and the vault pays out only when the thread shows a fresh relic each epoch. A relic cannot be copied — its signature binds the agent key and the task inputs — so one operator running a thousand fakes must produce a thousand fresh relics every epoch. Idle or duplicated threads seal their vaults shut and burn the locked stake inside, turning mass farming into a recurring compute bill, not a one-time trick.
